differences.what: Actual master reviewed: raising the bow eave from26.5 to27.33ft removes the former approximately0.25m vertical offset. Low planar copper slopes, attached seams and closed host intersections remain.

T-2861: the trough read on the section, at both ends: the south end drawn end-on (top at the hood's eave 27.38 ft, face 0.31 ft out from the wall line at S38.62, foot 27.0-27.04) and the north end cut against the north range (floor 27.04, lip 27.30, 0.35 ft out from S26.2). No fascia board is drawn under it; the brick runs up to the trough. Built: 0.094 m out from the wall, 0.11 m deep, its outlet at its middle, in place of the shared 0.18 m box hung 1.13 ft out. On the render the trough's face and foot fall within about 0.1 ft of the drawn lines, the top 0.05 ft under the drawn eave (the section/eave datum T-2228 records).

T-2861: sheet 4 ends the hood's copper at S38.62 (plan 39.27), on the bow wall's drawn face. The eave is set 0.05 ft past the built wall (was 0.20 m), so the hood now ends on the render at S38.73 (plan 39.38) against the drawn 38.62, the 0.09 ft that is T-2925's carried bow radius (the drawn bow ends 39.31, the built 39.4), not the hood's.

Not recorded before T-2861: the court-bow leader at the hood's north end. Sheet 4 draws it dropping from the trough at about S26.95 to 26.56 ft and offsetting north to S26.54 at 25.8 ft, with a ring at S26.45, 26.55 ft; the build's box leader drops about 0.5 ft further north, with no ring. T-2939 owns it. T-2939: read on the native sheet, the line is the front of a head drawn side-on, not the pipe offsetting: its back stays on the north range's court-face line (S26.2) from the trough's floor down, its front runs at S26.95 from 27.04 to 26.56 ft and then steps in to the pipe's front at S26.53 by 25.8 ft, so the pipe stands 0.33 ft (0.10 m) deep on that wall: the 100 mm side of the 160 x 100 mm stock, its broad face looking south. Built so: on the render the head's front runs at S26.95 from about 27.13 to 26.6 ft and meets the pipe at S26.53 by about 25.85 ft, the 0.05-0.1 ft high that is the section/eave datum T-2228 records; the pipe's front is at S26.53, and the old drop's box north of the wall line is gone. The ring (0.37 ft across, centred S26.47, 26.37 ft) and the small stud (0.12 ft, S26.72, 26.71 ft) drawn on the head's side are built as shallow round bosses on its west face; square to this camera and in the head's own finish they do not separate on the render, and what they are stays reconstructed.
Exact copper stock, sheet subdivision and1904 patina are reconstructed; the monochrome section cannot establish them.
